::: proof

#### Shorter proof

Apply the
[simplified expression for variance](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#thm-variance),
rearranged as $\E{X^2} = \Var{X} + \sqf{\E{X}}$,
to the [estimation error](#def-estimation-error) $X = \erf{\hparam}$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\pMSE{\hparam}
&= \E{\sqf{\erf{\hparam}}}
&& \text{(definition of pMSE)}\\
&= \Var{\erf{\hparam}} + \sqf{\E{\erf{\hparam}}}
&& \text{(second moment is variance plus squared mean)}\\
&= \Var{\hparam - \param} + \sqf{\bias{\hparam}}
&& \text{(definitions of estimation error and bias)}\\
&= \var{\hparam} + \sqf{\bias{\hparam}}
&& \text{(subtracting a constant does not change a variance)}
\end{aligned}
$$

This proof needs no cross term,
because the variance identity already separates the squared mean from the spread.

Source: @wikipedia_mean_squared_error.

:::
